title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
description: A murder mystery set in the English countryside, where the wealthy Mrs. And is poisoned under mysterious circumstances. The investigation uncovers secrets, lies, and a web of deceit involving the household and its inhabitants.
intro_narrative: The intense interest aroused in the public by what was known at the time as 'The Snape Case' has now somewhat subsided. Nevertheless, in view of the world-wide notoriety which attended it, I have been asked to write an account of the whole story. Mrs. And, a wealthy and generous woman, is found dead in her locked bedroom, seemingly from strychnine poisoning. The household is thrown into chaos, and suspicions arise about various members, including her husband, stepsons, and other residents of Snape Court.
